member.name: M:LocationBeacon.Services.LocationService.TryGetLocationWithAdaptiveTimeout
member.summary: Attempts to acquire location with adaptive timeout. Timeout escalates with each failed attempt: 3s, 5s, 7s, ... up to 20s per attempt. Across all attempts in a cycle, total timeout is capped at 60 seconds. Returns (0, 0, 0) if location cannot be acquired. Resets attempt count to 0 on success.
